import cadquery as cq
import math

# Create the cylinder
result = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0272).extrude(0.75)

# Create a plane for the cut
plane = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0544, 0.0544).circle(0.0272)

# Create the cut cylinder
cylinder2 = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=0.75) \
    .center(0.0544, 0.0544).circle(0.0272).extrude(-0.75)

# Combine
r = result.cut(cylinder2)

import cadquery as cq

# Cylinder with diameter 0.0544 and height 0.75
cyl = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0544 / 2).extrude(0.75)

# Slot cut through the cylinder along its full length (seen as a line in RIGHT view)
slot_width = 0.004
slot = cq.Workplane("XZ").center(0, 0.375).rect(slot_width, 0.9).extrude(0.2, both=True)

r = cyl.cut(slot)
